topic: The ancient civilization that vanished overnight without a single trace
hook: An entire civilization vanished overnight with no explanation.
script: An entire civilization vanished overnight with no explanation. The Indus Valley Civilization was one of the most advanced of the ancient world. Running water. Grid-planned cities. A written language. Then around 1900 BC — nothing. No war evidence. No mass graves. No natural disaster. They simply ceased. Their language remains undeciphered. We still don't know why. Follow for history mysteries with no answers.
